notes.title: Notification of Issue Resolution and Release for Steam® Version Ver1.5.0
notes.notes:
The issue with price settings for the Steam® version update and additional music pack has been resolved, and the distribution has now begun.

We sincerely apologize for the great inconvenience caused to those who have been eagerly awaiting this update and DLC.
We kindly ask for your continued support of KAMITSUBAKI CITY ENSEMBLE.

notes.title: [Notice and Apology for Steam® Version Ver1.5.0 Release Delay]
notes.notes:
Due to an issue with price settings, the Steam® version update and additional music pack, originally scheduled for release on Thursday, January 30, have been postponed and will be released in the near future.

We sincerely apologize for the great inconvenience caused to those who have been eagerly awaiting this update and DLC.

The new release date will be announced on our official website and X as soon as it is determined.

Please note that the update and additional content will be released as scheduled on other platforms (iOS, Android, Nintendo Switch™︎, PlayStation®5).

Once again, we deeply apologize for the burden and inconvenience caused to our customers.

We kindly ask for your continued support of KAMITSUBAKI CITY ENSEMBLE.
